items.title: Garaticker · Help
items.text:
Garaticker is a free app of Canarian sticker packs, made by artists from the islands. It comes from Sanchesque Studios. You can get it on Android and on iPhone (on iPhone it includes an iMessage extension).

Pick a pack, tap a button and use it in your chats. No account, no ads, no purchases.

items.title: Where you can use them
items.text:
Platform How WhatsApp From the app, with the "Add to WhatsApp" button Telegram From the app, with the "Open in Telegram" button Signal Packs published separately, with one emoji per sticker iMessage iPhone only, with the Garaticker extension in Messages

Animated packs are also on GIPHY. Search for Garaticker stickers in apps that use GIPHY. More in the FAQ.

items.title: More help
items.text:
• Missing some stickers? Ask for them from the "Request" tab.
  • FAQ: free, offline, removing packs, artists and more.

items.title: Contact
items.text: Something not working, or a question? Write to us at hello@sanchesque.com. Tell us which phone you have, the app version and what happened.

items.title: Is Garaticker free?
items.text: Yes. There are no purchases, paid packs or ads.

items.title: Do I need an account?
items.text: No. There is no sign-up and we do not ask for your name, email or phone.

items.title: Which platforms can I use the stickers on?
items.text: On WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and iMessage (iPhone only). The Android app does not include iMessage, because it does not exist on Android.

items.title: What is GIPHY and where are the stickers there?
items.text: GIPHY is a search engine for GIFs and stickers used by many apps. Garaticker's animated stickers are there. Search for "Garaticker" in apps that use GIPHY. Static packs are not published on GIPHY.

items.title: Does it work offline?
items.text: Packs you already downloaded stay in the app. Offline, the catalog does not update and the app tells you: "Offline: the catalog was not updated. Your downloaded packs are still here." To download a new pack you need a connection.

items.title: How do I save my favorite stickers?
items.text: Press and hold a sticker and choose "Add to favorites". You will find them in the "Favorites" tab. To remove one, choose "Remove from favorites".

items.title: Can I share a single sticker?
items.text: Yes. Open the sticker and tap "Share" to send it to any app. On iPhone you can also tap "Copy".

items.title: How do I remove a pack?
items.text: Packs added to WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal are removed from those apps, in your sticker list. In Garaticker you do not need to remove anything.

items.title: Who makes the stickers?
items.text: Artists from the islands. Garaticker brings together packs by Sanchesque Studios and by guest artists. In the "Artists" tab you can see who is who, with their links and packs. Each pack carries its author's name.

items.title: Can I change the language?
items.text: The app is in Spanish and English. Change it in "Settings", under "Language", which opens your phone's language setting.

items.title: Can I ask for new stickers?
items.text: Yes, from the "Request" tab. See how it works.

items.title: How do I report a problem?
items.text: Write to us at hello@sanchesque.com with your phone, the app version and what happened. First, check the page for your platform: WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal or iMessage.

items.title: What data do you keep?
items.text: Very little. You do not need an account: the app does not ask for your name, email or phone number. There are no ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics. Your favourites and settings stay on your phone. If you send a request, see what is stored.

items.title: Stickers in iMessage
items.text: iMessage exists only on iPhone. The iPhone app includes a Garaticker extension that works inside Messages, without leaving the conversation.

items.title: Step by step
items.text:
1. Open Garaticker once so it downloads the packs. If you skip this, the extension reminds you with "Open Garaticker to download the stickers".
  2. Open a conversation in Messages and tap +.
  3. Choose Garaticker.
  4. Tap a sticker to send it, or drag it onto a message.

items.title: What you will see in the extension
items.text:
• Compact view (the drawer under the keyboard): "Favorites" and "Recent" first, then all packs.
  • Expanded view: search ("Search Garaticker"), with quick links to Favorites and to each pack.
  • The extension follows Messages' light or dark mode.

If the drawer is empty, tap "Open Garaticker" and download the packs. The ones you download in the app show up here.

items.title: Common problems
items.text:
I do not see Garaticker when I tap +. Swipe along the row of apps in Messages and look for it. If it is not there, open Garaticker once and try again.

The extension is empty. No packs have been downloaded yet. Open Garaticker, let it load the catalog and go back to Messages.

I want my favorites. They are saved in the app ("Favorites" tab) and appear first in the extension.

iMessage does not exist on Android. There you can use WhatsApp or Telegram. More in the FAQ.

items.title: Request stickers
items.text: Missing a theme? Know someone who draws really well? The Request tab is for that. We read everything.

items.title: How to send a request
items.text:
1. Open the "Request" tab.
  2. Choose "Suggest a theme" or "Recommend a creator".
  3. Write your idea (1 to 500 characters). If you recommend a creator, tell us who draws and where we can see their work.
  4. Tap Send request.

You will see "Request sent. Thank you".

items.title: What is sent
items.text:
Only the text you write, the type of request, the app language, whether you use Android or iPhone, and a time. We do not ask for your name, email or phone, and you do not need an account. The request is anonymous.

Please do not put personal data in the text. Only the studio reads it, never other users.

items.title: Limits
items.text:
• You can send one request a day. If you already sent one, the app tells you how long is left ("You can send another in … h").
  • The text can be up to 500 characters.
  • If sending fails (for example, no connection), your text is kept so you can try again.

items.title: What happens next
items.text:
Requests are reviewed about once a month, and new packs come out of that review, also in monthly batches. A request can therefore take up to a month to be read.

We do not reply to requests. We have no contact details for you, so we cannot tell you that your idea was picked. If a pack comes out of your idea, you will see it in "Explore".

More questions in the FAQ.

items.title: Stickers on Signal
items.text: Signal has no button like WhatsApp's. Garaticker packs for Signal are published separately, by hand, so they may come out a little later than on other platforms.

items.title: How to add a pack
items.text:
Signal saves sticker packs from a pack link. With the link on your phone:

  1. Open the pack link.
  2. Signal shows the pack. Tap the button to install it.
  3. In a chat, tap the sticker icon and find the pack in your list.

The exact steps can change with Signal versions. If something does not match, see Signal's own help (support.signal.org, "Stickers" article).

items.title: What is special about it
items.text:
• One emoji per sticker. Signal supports only one emoji for each sticker, so on Signal you will see just one, even if the sticker has several on other platforms.
  • Packs cannot be edited. Once a pack is published on Signal, it cannot be changed or deleted. If something needs fixing, a new pack is published.
  • Animated. Packs with an animated version have their stickers animated on Signal.

items.title: Common problems
items.text:
I cannot find the pack in Signal. Check that you opened the pack link and tapped the button to install it. Update Signal if it does not work.

A pack I saw is not on Signal. Not every pack is published on every platform. Try WhatsApp or Telegram.

More in the FAQ.

items.title: Add stickers to Telegram
items.text: Telegram can keep a pack without Garaticker being installed, but the app makes it a single tap.

items.title: Step by step
items.text:
1. Open Garaticker and go into a pack.
  2. Tap Open in Telegram.
  3. Telegram opens with the pack on screen. Tap Telegram's button to add it to your stickers.
  4. Open a chat, tap the emoji icon and go to the sticker tab. It is there.

It works the same on Android and iPhone.

items.title: Static and animated
items.text: Each pack can have two sets on Telegram: one with static stickers and one with animated (video) stickers. If there is an animated version, you will see both. Set titles are in Spanish.

items.title: Common problems
items.text:
Telegram does not open. Check that it is installed and up to date. If not, install it from Google Play or the App Store and tap Open in Telegram again.

The pack does not show up in my stickers. Tap Open in Telegram again and add it from Telegram's screen.

Animated stickers do not move. Update Telegram.

More questions in the FAQ.

items.title: Add stickers to WhatsApp
items.text: This is the easiest one: one button per pack.

items.title: Step by step
items.text:
1. Open Garaticker and go into a pack from the "Explore" tab.
  2. If the pack has an animated version, choose "Static" or "Animated" above the stickers. WhatsApp does not mix the two in one pack.
  3. Tap Add to WhatsApp. The button shows progress while the pack downloads.
  4. WhatsApp asks you to confirm. Accept.
  5. When it all went well, the button changes to "Added to WhatsApp".
  6. Open any WhatsApp chat, tap the emoji icon and go to the sticker tab. Your pack is there.

The process is the same on Android and iPhone. On Android, the confirmation dialog is WhatsApp's own.

items.title: Before you start
items.text:
• WhatsApp must be installed on your phone and up to date.
  • You need a connection to download the pack the first time.

items.title: Common problems
items.text:
It says "WhatsApp not found". The app cannot detect WhatsApp. Install it from Google Play (Android) or the App Store (iPhone), or use Telegram.

It says "The pack could not be added. Try again." Check your connection and tap the button again. If it keeps failing, update WhatsApp and Garaticker.

Stickers do not show up in WhatsApp. Close WhatsApp and open it again. If the pack still does not show up, remove it in WhatsApp and add it again from Garaticker.

I want both an animated and a static pack. They are two separate packs in WhatsApp. Add each one on its own from the pack screen.

I want to remove a pack. You do it from WhatsApp, in your sticker list. See also the FAQ.

If nothing works, write to us (contact details on the home page).
